description: Daily phone-queue metrics for the City of Kitchener contact centre, one row per day from 1 March 2019 to 30 July 2023, with calendar and holiday flags. Days with an incomplete or duplicated set of metrics are excluded.
source: City of Kitchener Open Data, phone queue metrics dataset; Ontario statutory holidays from https://github.com/uWaterloo/Datasets
licence: Open Government Licence – Kitchener (metrics); holidays file as licensed in its repository
notes: The service-level target is 30 seconds on every day in the data.
